info.name: EShop HW06 — API Testing (23127152)
info.description:
HW06 API tests for EShop SUT.

APIs locked:
- Pool A FR-05: GET /api/products
- Pool B FR-11: GET /api/orders/my-orders, GET /api/orders/:id
- Pool C FR-15: POST/PUT/DELETE /api/products

Every request includes header X-Student-Id via collection pre-request script.

item.name: API1 — FR-05 Products List/Search
item.description: Executable suite mapped to TC-A1-* / TC-A1-E* (≥35 designed; subset automated in Newman).

exec: pm.test('TC-A1-001 JSON array ≥1', () => { const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(j.length).to.be.above(0); pm.environment.set('baselineCount', String(j.length)); });
pm.test('TC-A1-033 required fields', () => { const p=pm.response.json()[0]; ['id','name','price','description','imageUrl','category_id'].forEach(k => pm.expect(p).to.have.property(k)); });
pm.test('TC-A1-034/035 types', () => { const p=pm.response.json()[0]; pm.expect(p.id).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(p.name).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(p.price).to.be.a('number'); });
pm.test('X-Student-Id was sent', () => { const h=pm.request.headers.get('X-Student-Id'); pm.expect(h).to.eql('23127152'); console.log('X-Student-Id=' + h); });
pm.test('TC-A1-002 all names contain iPhone', () => { const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.length).to.be.above(0); j.forEach(p => pm.expect(p.name.toLowerCase()).to.include('iphone')); });
pm.test('TC-A1-004/037 empty []', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.eql([]); });
pm.test('TC-A1-005 200 full list', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(j.length).to.be.above(0); });
pm.test('TC-A1-013 match AirPods', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.some(p => p.name.includes('AirPods'))).to.be.true; });
pm.test('TC-A1-019 same baseline count', () => { const n=pm.response.json().length; const b=Number(pm.environment.get('baselineCount')||n); pm.expect(n).to.eql(b); });
